sections.title: What Zhatura is
sections.content: Zhatura is an AI-powered chess learning platform. Zhatura AI is the name of the learning platform.

sections.title: What problem Zhatura solves
sections.content: Zhatura helps students and children learn chess with AI support. It also helps parents, coaches, academies and organizations follow and manage chess learning.

sections.title: Who Zhatura is for
sections.content: Zhatura serves students and children learning chess, parents who want to follow their child's learning, chess coaches, chess academies and similar organizations, and prospective customers who want to know what Zhatura offers.

sections.title: How Zhatura is different from a normal chess app
sections.content: Zhatura is an AI-powered learning platform rather than only a chess-playing app. It uses the Zhatura AI Chess Coach alongside dashboards for students, parents and coaches.

sections.title: What the support line can do
sections.content: This phone line is Zhatura's AI customer support. It can answer general verified questions about Zhatura, its dashboards and its AI Chess Coach, and it supports many Indian languages. It cannot access individual customer accounts in the current phase.

sections.title: What the AI Chess Coach is
sections.content: The Zhatura AI Chess Coach is Zhatura's AI coach for learning chess. Children use the AI Chess Coach as part of the Zhatura learning platform. It exists alongside the Student, Parent and Coach Dashboards.

sections.title: What the AI Chess Coach can explain generally
sections.content: The AI Chess Coach supports a child's chess learning journey. It can explain chess concepts, point out mistakes and suggest what to focus on next during practice and review.

sections.title: Detailed coaching mechanics not yet documented
sections.content: Exactly how coaching sessions, exercises, feedback timing or personalized lesson plans are structured is not yet documented in verified Zhatura sources. If a caller asks for that level of detail, say the verified details are not available yet rather than guessing.

sections.title: Mistake explanation and recommendations
sections.content: The AI Chess Coach can explain why a move was a mistake and recommend a better idea. Specific recommendation rules, mistake categories and skill-mapping are not yet documented in verified sources.

sections.title: Personalization and learning adaptation
sections.content: Whether the coach adapts automatically to a student's level, tracks strengths and weaknesses, or builds custom training plans is not yet documented in verified sources. Do not claim personalization features that are not verified.

sections.title: Student Dashboard
sections.content: Students log in through the Student Dashboard. This is the verified student entry point into Zhatura.

sections.title: Learning activities
sections.content: What exactly students see and do after logging in — for example the precise list of learning activities, puzzles, game analysis tools or lesson schedules — is not yet documented in verified Zhatura sources. Do not invent a feature list; say the detailed student feature list is not yet available in verified documentation.

sections.title: Practice and game history
sections.content: Whether the Student Dashboard shows past games, practice sets, achievements, ratings or progress history is not yet documented in verified sources. Keep answers general unless verified details are added later.

sections.title: Coach interaction for students
sections.content: How students interact with a coach inside Zhatura — for example assignments, reviews or messages — is not yet documented in verified sources.

sections.title: Parent Dashboard and progress
sections.content: Zhatura has a Parent Dashboard. Parents can view their child's chess learning progress in the Parent Dashboard.

sections.title: Lesson and activity visibility
sections.content: Whether parents can see lesson history, upcoming sessions, time spent, specific scores or activity details is not yet documented in verified Zhatura sources. Do not invent reports or controls.

sections.title: Verified status: no plan data yet
sections.content: There is currently NO verified Zhatura plan, package, subscription, price, discount, refund, renewal or free-trial information in the knowledge base. The correct answer to any plan, package or pricing question is that verified plan details are not available yet — never quote or invent a price, plan name, discount, renewal term or trial term. Offer to help with other Zhatura questions or to note the pricing question for the support team.

sections.title: What to avoid
sections.content: Never say a specific amount in rupees, dollars or any currency. Never name a plan such as "Basic", "Pro", "Family" or "Academy" unless it appears in a verified source. Never promise a trial length, discount percentage or refund window.

sections.title: What the AI support agent can help with
sections.content: The AI support agent can answer general verified questions about Zhatura, its dashboards and the AI Chess Coach, and it can guide callers to the right support path. It cannot access accounts or perform technical fixes.

sections.title: App or dashboard not loading
sections.content: If the app or dashboard is not loading, general checks such as internet connection, browser refresh or restarting the app may help. Specific platform recovery steps are not yet documented in verified sources.

sections.title: Lesson or session not visible
sections.content: If a lesson or session is not visible, this may be account-specific. The assistant cannot see the user's account or session status. Explain how sessions normally work in general, then offer a support next step.

sections.title: Audio or voice issue
sections.content: Audio and voice issues during a phone call may relate to the caller's device, network or the telephony connection. The assistant can note the issue for the support team.

sections.title: When to escalate
sections.content: Escalate to human support when the caller needs account access, billing help, technical fixes, or any action the AI assistant cannot perform in this phase.

sections.title: Languages the support line can converse in
sections.content: The support line can converse in English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi and Odia. It also understands more Indian languages.

sections.title: STT understanding coverage
sections.content: Zhatura Speech Recognition supports many Indian languages and code-mixed speech. Coverage quality may vary by language, accent and background noise.

sections.title: LLM response capability
sections.content: The LLM can reply in the requested or detected language, including Indian English, Hinglish and Tanglish code-mixing. It preserves natural code-switching rather than translating everything into plain English.

sections.title: TTS voice coverage
sections.content: TTS voices are available for the supported languages through the Zhatura Voice Engine. Voice quality and available speakers may vary by language.

sections.title: Fallback behaviour
sections.content: If a language cannot be answered aloud, the system falls back according to the telephony configuration. The assistant should not claim a language is unavailable unless the system explicitly indicates it.
